# Sprint NN Review and retrospective

Date/window, goal, source scope and review identity (self/independent/human).

## Outcomes and evidence

Delivered/carried/dropped story IDs with acceptance, exact check results and local
artifact paths. State failures, unrun checks and release gates. No pasted logs.

## Quality and AI effectiveness

Before/after source inventory, large files, relevant performance and UX evidence.
Record review/rework rounds, defects escaped/reopened, spec deviations and user
interventions. Missing observations are unknown, never zero. Explain tradeoffs;
LOC or green compilation alone does not prove quality.

## Retrospective and planning

What helped, what caused rework, and at most two improvements with owner, linked
story and measurable success condition. Update backlog/roadmap, carry work with
reasons and propose next scope/capacity from observed delivery.
